review_mode: Independent read-only source review and small Arrow/numpy floating equality probes; no bulk work or edits by reviewer.

findings.finding: Attribute comparison materializes an entire source column, output column and restored copy; batch size does not bound this phase. Hash arrays scale with row count.
findings.disposition: Documented scope and scaling. The selected full datasets must pass measured peak-RSS checks; no general constant-memory claim, no cap increase or waiver. A failure or OOM cannot yield passing fidelity evidence.

findings.finding: Arrow and numpy value equality equate +0 and -0; unchanged NaNs can be rejected.
findings.disposition: Documented numeric-value semantics. Acceptance requires decoded attribute values/types/nulls, not bitwise floating-buffer identity. WKB has independent full per-feature SHA-256, length and null comparisons. Signed-zero bits are not certified.

otherwise_checked: complete one-based native ID range and multiplicity
attribute values/nulls after restoring ID order
required_followup: Complete full first/clean transforms under the unchanged 1GB peak gate and exact file-hash reproducibility before promotion.
